explication: BLEUnlock is a macOS menu-bar utility that monitors a selected BLE device and locks or unlocks the Mac according to proximity. The main flow is menu-based device selection, BLE scanning and RSSI/presence tracking, then lock/unlock actions with configurable thresholds and timing. The README also documents optional playback control, scripts, display waking, screensaver locking, and Keychain password storage. Some feature modules are not sampled, so their paths use the existing BLEUnlock directory and uncertain implementation links are omitted.
